title.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛
title.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and the inverse sieve

description.zh: 在同一个偶数的 Farey 插入层上给中心窗分母加上逆元标记。比较全窗 CRT 和分窗模双曲线计数，再按最小素因子计算筛损失。
description.en: Label the central denominator pairs on a single Farey insertion layer by their inverses. Compare full-window CRT counts with modular hyperbola counts in subwindows, then group sieve losses by the least prime factor.
